title: Dave Chase (Health Rosetta CEO, Relocalizing Health author) — 'organizational corruption isn't a character problem. It's a design problem.'
summary: Chase co-founded Health Rosetta and is its CEO, and wrote Relocalizing Health. His LinkedIn Pulse essay argues that Incorruptible is the business book healthcare leaders most need because it is not a healthcare book, then maps the mission-locked constellation framework onto the community-owned health plan model he has spent a decade building.
blockquote: organizational corruption isn't a character problem. It's a design problem.
attribution_title: CEO & Co-Founder, Health Rosetta; Board Chair, Nautilus Health Institute; Author, Relocalizing Health
